delta_gap.reading: Read as: **at these sizes, more data of this kind is not measurably closing the gap.** That is the more actionable outcome of the two for the question this curve was funded to answer -- it is evidence against buying more labels of the same kind as a way to close the distance to the comparators, and it is NOT evidence that the gap is fixed, because an interval covering zero covers useful narrowing as well as none.
